messages:
Noah: quick heads up 1 PR #3699 (SDK migration + examples) needs docs eyes. preview will be up in a sec.
Zara: assigning @Ethan and @Maya for review. Ethan can check snippets, Maya can check tone.
Ethan: looking now. main things: JS snippet still uses promise-style callback; we prefer async/await in examples.
Maya: tone pass: a couple places say 'we will' 1 per style guide use 'we recommend' or state as factual requirement only. Avoid marketing-y phrasing.
style-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/3699 1 link-check passed. CI: docs-lint -> failed (MD code-fence language mismatch).
Noah: noted. @Olga can you run the lint fix? probably just add the language tag for the Go block.
Olga: on it. will change JS to async/await and tag all code fences. will also update the 'model' -> 'model family' wording that Ethan flagged.
Ethan: thanks. also add a short expected-output comment for the JS example and update param names to snake_case for Python snippets.
Olga: pushed at 2050012480. fixed fences, updated examples, and softened 'we will' -> 'we recommend'.
style-bot: New preview built: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/3699/2 1 CI: all checks green.
Maya: re-reviewed. LGTM on tone. One tiny nit: change 'shouldn't' -> 'do not' in the security notes (avoid contractions in safety-critical notes).
Ethan: approving for code examples. added a short inline comment noting SDK version compatibility (>=1.5.0).
Zara: approved. Noah, we'll merge during the 2:30pm PT docs slot at 2050012600 unless any rollback needed.
Noah: merging at 2050012600. PR body updated with changelog: 'Aligned snippets to async/await, added SDK version note, standardized tone.'
style-bot: Merged by Noah at 2050012600. Release note: docs: example modernization + tone edits.
Olga: nice teamwork, thanks all :sparkles:
